items.title: Require a recorded dev-memory preflight acknowledgement before a story may enter DEV
items.context: Mirrors the existing scope_boundary_set/execution_boundary_set/scope_freeze_check INIT_CHECK-gating pattern. New command (e.g. dev_memory_preflight_ack) writes a JSON artifact under .lattice/story/actives/<id>/ recording that dev_memory_preflight was run and its topHitIds were seen; the DEV-entry gate refuses to advance without this artifact present and bound to the current story's material.

happy.desc: Story in PLAN with no dev-memory-preflight-ack.json artifact -> call dev_memory_preflight_ack -> artifact written -> canStartDevGuard allows PLAN->DEV transition; WHY: confirms the primary happy path (ack exists -> gate opens)

evaluateDevMemoryPreflightGate returns true when a valid dev-memory-preflight-ack.json exists for the story, regardless of its packDigest/topHitIds content; WHY: existence-only check per plan (not hash/staleness-bound)

getGuardFailureReason for targetPhase=DEV includes missing_dev_memory_preflight_ack tag and actionable run-command hint when ack artifact is absent; WHY: confirms user-visible error message is helpful

edge.desc: Story re-entering DEV from REVIEW (canReenterDevGuard) with ack already present from first PLAN->DEV entry -> gate passes with zero added friction; WHY: ack persists for story lifetime, rollback doors must not re-prompt
Story skipping PLAN (canSkipPlanGuard) still requires the ack artifact and blocks without it; WHY: all four DEV doors must be gated, not just the PLAN->DEV path

dev_memory_preflight_ack writes artifact with correct schema (schemaVersion, storyId, packDigest, topHitIds, acknowledgedAt, acknowledgedBy) and is readable by evaluateDevMemoryPreflightGate; WHY: round-trip data integrity

adversarial.desc: All four DEV-entry doors (canStartDevGuard, canSkipPlanGuard, canReenterDevGuard from REVIEW, canReenterDevGuard from TEST) block when dev-memory-preflight-ack.json is absent; WHY: adversarial check that gate is wired into EVERY door, not just the primary PLAN->DEV path the story emphasizes

Deleting/truncating dev-memory-preflight-ack.json after it was written -> evaluateDevMemoryPreflightGate returns false (fail-closed, treats missing/corrupt as blocking); WHY: prevents bypass via file deletion or corruption

dev-memory-preflight-ack.json containing invalid JSON (e.g. truncated, empty object {}, wrong schemaVersion) -> evaluateDevMemoryPreflightGate treats it as absent (fail-closed); WHY: a corrupt or hand-crafted artifact must not satisfy the gate

items.title: Append a non-blocking dev-memory capture reminder to finding_resolve output
items.context: After finding_resolve completes, append advisory text (does not block, does not mutate anything else) prompting the caller to consider dev_memory_capture for the finding's root cause/fix if it represents a genuinely reusable lesson.

items.title: Require a recorded dev_memory_finish_decision before a story may reach DONE
items.context: Add to canFinishGuard (core/machine.ts) or wherever the DONE checklist is assembled: require a dev_memory_finish_decision record for the story, accepting captured | no-reusable-lesson | defer-with-reason as satisfying answers. Mirrors how summary_set/delivery-check are already required DONE items.
